scope: Workflow-safe documented options. Bundled offline reference manuals are available from every tool page.

tools.label: FastQC
tools.summary: Quality diagnostics for raw and cleaned short-read FASTQ files.

options.label: Do not group bases for long reads
options.description: Show every base position instead of grouping positions above 50 bp.

options.label: Extract the FastQC archive
options.description: Extract the generated FastQC ZIP after analysis.

options.label: K-mer length
options.description: K-mer size used by the overrepresented k-mer module.

tools.label: fastp
tools.summary: Adapter, quality and length filtering for short reads.

options.label: Correct paired-end overlaps
options.description: Correct mismatched bases in confidently overlapping read pairs.

options.label: Trim poly-G tails
options.description: Enable poly-G tail trimming.

options.label: Trim poly-X tails
options.description: Enable poly-X tail trimming.

options.label: Filter low-complexity reads
options.description: Discard reads below the selected sequence-complexity threshold.

options.label: Complexity threshold (%)
options.description: Minimum percentage of adjacent bases that differ when low-complexity filtering is enabled.

tools.label: Cutadapt
tools.summary: Adapter trimming and read filtering for short reads.

options.label: Trim terminal N bases
options.description: Remove N bases from both ends of each read.

options.label: Discard reads without an adapter
options.description: Keep only reads in which a configured adapter was found.

options.label: Disallow indels in adapter matching
options.description: Permit substitutions only when matching adapters.

options.label: Maximum adapter error rate
options.description: Maximum error rate allowed in an adapter match.

options.label: Minimum adapter overlap
options.description: Minimum number of matching adapter bases.

options.label: Adapter-removal rounds
options.description: Repeat adapter removal this many times per read.

options.label: Maximum N content
options.description: Discard reads whose N content exceeds this fraction.

tools.label: MultiQC
tools.summary: Aggregates quality-control reports across all samples.

options.label: Ignore symbolic links
options.description: Do not traverse symbolic links while scanning reports.

options.label: Require requested module logs
options.description: Fail if an explicitly selected module finds no logs.

options.label: Report title
options.description: Custom title shown inside the MultiQC report.

options.label: Ignore path glob
options.description: Ignore one filename or path glob while scanning.

tools.label: Bowtie2 build
tools.summary: Builds the Bowtie2 reference index.

options.label: Force a large index
options.description: Use the large-index format even for a small reference.

options.label: Use packed strings
options.description: Reduce memory use during index construction at a speed cost.

options.label: Suffix-array sampling rate
options.description: Larger values create a smaller, slower index.

options.label: Lookup-table prefix length
options.description: Number of initial characters used by the lookup table.

tools.label: Bowtie2 alignment
tools.summary: Accuracy-first short-read alignment with preset and end-to-end/local mode configured here.

options.label: Alignment preset
options.description: Bowtie2 effort/sensitivity preset. Sensitive is the application default; default uses Bowtie2's built-in preset.

options.label: Alignment mode
options.description: End-to-end requires the full read to align; local allows soft-clipped ends.

options.label: Seed mismatches
options.description: Maximum mismatches allowed in a seed.

options.label: Seed length
options.description: Length of each seed substring.

options.label: Minimum-score function
options.description: Bowtie2 function defining the minimum valid alignment score.

options.label: Allow dovetailing pairs
options.description: Treat dovetailing paired-end alignments as concordant.

options.label: Reject overlapping mates
options.description: Do not consider overlapping mate alignments concordant.

options.label: Reject contained mates
options.description: Do not consider a mate contained within the other concordant.

options.label: Suppress unaligned SAM records
options.description: Omit unaligned reads from Bowtie2 SAM output.

options.label: Ignore base qualities
options.description: Treat all mismatch quality penalties as the highest quality.

tools.label: BWA-MEM2 index
tools.summary: Builds the BWA-MEM2 index. Its useful arguments are workflow-owned, so no curated override is offered.
pipeline_managed: index prefix and expected index files

tools.label: BWA-MEM2 alignment
tools.summary: Alternative short-read alignment used for accuracy auditing or as a primary method.

options.label: Minimum seed length
options.description: Minimum exact-match seed length.

options.label: Alignment band width
options.description: Band width used for extension alignment.

options.label: Mismatch penalty
options.description: Penalty assigned to a mismatch.

options.label: Gap-open penalties
options.description: Deletion and insertion gap-open penalties.

options.label: Gap-extension penalties
options.description: Deletion and insertion gap-extension penalties.

options.label: Mark shorter split hits secondary
options.description: Compatibility behavior used by some Picard workflows.

tools.label: HISAT2 build
tools.summary: Builds the unspliced HISAT2 reference index.

options.label: Force a large index
options.description: Use the large-index format regardless of reference size.

options.label: Use packed strings
options.description: Reduce memory during index construction at a speed cost.

options.label: Suffix-array sampling rate
options.description: Larger values create a smaller, slower index.

options.label: Lookup-table prefix length
options.description: Number of initial characters used by the lookup table.

tools.label: HISAT2 alignment
tools.summary: HISAT2 configured for bacterial, no-splice, no-softclip alignment.

options.label: Sensitivity preset
options.description: Select a HISAT2 effort/sensitivity preset; default adds no preset flag.

options.label: Seed mismatches
options.description: Maximum mismatches allowed in a seed.

options.label: Seed length
options.description: Length of each seed substring.

options.label: Minimum-score function
options.description: Function defining the minimum valid alignment score.

options.label: Suppress unaligned SAM records
options.description: Omit unaligned reads from HISAT2 SAM output.

options.label: Ignore base qualities
options.description: Use constant mismatch penalties instead of qualities.

tools.label: SAMtools faidx
tools.summary: Creates the reference FASTA index required by later tools. Output-changing flags are intentionally protected.

tools.label: SAMtools sort
tools.summary: Creates coordinate-sorted BAM files for counting, coverage and indexing.

options.label: BAM compression level
options.description: 0 is fastest/largest; 9 is smallest/slowest; -1 uses the library default.

options.label: Memory per thread
options.description: Approximate maximum memory per sorting thread, with K/M/G suffix.

options.label: Do not add a @PG line
options.description: Suppress the SAM header program record for this command.

tools.label: SAMtools merge
tools.summary: Combines technical runs belonging to the same biological sample.

options.label: Combine colliding @PG IDs
options.description: Keep a single program record when IDs collide.

options.label: Combine colliding @RG IDs
options.description: Keep a single read-group record when IDs collide.

options.label: Do not add a @PG line
options.description: Suppress the merge program record in the header.

tools.label: SAMtools index
tools.summary: Creates the BAI index expected beside each final BAM. CSI/output-changing flags are protected.

tools.label: SAMtools fastq
tools.summary: Converts supplied or Dorado-produced BAM data to FASTQ.

options.label: Use read names
options.description: Use the read name instead of adding /1 and /2 suffixes.

options.label: Always add /1 and /2
options.description: Always append mate suffixes to read names.

options.label: Use OQ quality values
options.description: Use original qualities from the OQ tag when present.

options.label: Copy RG, BC and QT tags
options.description: Add common read-group and barcode tags to FASTQ headers.

tools.label: SAMtools quickcheck
tools.summary: Verifies BAM headers and end-of-file blocks. Its verbose integrity behavior is workflow-owned.

tools.label: SAMtools flagstat
tools.summary: Produces alignment flag statistics parsed into the suite's alignment summary. Report-format changes are therefore workflow-owned.
pipeline_managed: report destination and downstream summary parser

tools.label: SAMtools stats
tools.summary: Produces detailed alignment statistics for audit and QC.

options.label: Remove paired-read overlaps
options.description: Avoid counting overlapped paired-end bases twice in statistics.

options.label: Required SAM flags
options.description: Include only reads containing all specified SAM flag bits.

options.label: Excluded SAM flags
options.description: Exclude reads containing any specified SAM flag bits.

tools.label: SAMtools idxstats
tools.summary: Reports mapped and unmapped read counts per reference sequence. Input/index arguments are protected.

tools.label: Dorado basecaller
tools.summary: Basecalls Oxford Nanopore POD5 input using the selected HAC or SUP model.

options.label: Compute device
options.description: Select automatic, CPU, all NVIDIA GPUs, or the first NVIDIA GPU in the WSL/Linux runtime.

options.label: Inference batch size
options.description: 0 leaves hardware-specific selection to Dorado; larger values use more accelerator memory.

options.label: Minimum mean Q score
options.description: Discard basecalls below this mean quality threshold.

options.label: Write move-table tags
options.description: Store the move table in mv tags for compatible downstream uses.

options.label: Scan POD5 folders recursively
options.description: Search subdirectories for POD5 files.

tools.label: Chopper
tools.summary: Optional quality and length filtering for long reads.

options.label: Maximum read length
options.description: Discard reads longer than this many bases. Leave Use unchecked for Chopper's unrestricted maximum.

options.label: Keep reads that fail filters
options.description: Invert the filtering decision for diagnostic use.

tools.label: pigz compression
tools.summary: Parallel gzip compression for generated FASTQ files.

options.label: Compression level
options.description: 1 is fastest/largest; 9 is slowest/smallest; default uses pigz's standard level.

options.label: Rsync-friendly blocks
options.description: Reset compression blocks at input-dependent boundaries.

options.label: Independent compression blocks
options.description: Compress blocks independently for damage isolation.

options.label: Do not store name/time
options.description: Omit original filename and timestamp metadata.

tools.label: NanoPlot
tools.summary: Quality and length plots for long-read FASTQ data.

options.label: Distribution plot type
options.description: Rendering method for bivariate distribution plots.

options.label: Show N50 mark
options.description: Add the read N50 value to length plots.

options.label: Log-transform read length
options.description: Use a logarithmic read-length axis.

options.label: Downsample to N reads
options.description: Use at most this many reads for plotting. Leave Use unchecked to disable explicit downsampling.

options.label: Static plot format
options.description: File format for static figures.

tools.label: LongQC
tools.summary: Optional long-read quality audit. Options vary substantially by LongQC revision, so use its linked manual for uncommon overrides.

tools.label: minimap2
tools.summary: Primary or audit alignment for Oxford Nanopore and PacBio reads.

options.label: Minimizer k-mer length
options.description: Length of minimizer k-mers.

options.label: Minimizer window size
options.description: Window size used to select minimizers.

options.label: Match score
options.description: Score assigned to a matching base.

options.label: Mismatch penalty
options.description: Penalty assigned to a mismatch.

options.label: Gap-open penalties
options.description: Short and long gap-open penalties.

options.label: Gap-extension penalties
options.description: Short and long gap-extension penalties.

options.label: Use = and X CIGAR operators
options.description: Distinguish matches and mismatches in CIGAR output.

options.label: Write MD tags
options.description: Add the MD mismatch tag to SAM records.

tools.label: Winnowmap
tools.summary: Repeat-aware long-read audit alignment using a meryl repetitive-k-mer list.

options.label: Minimizer k-mer length
options.description: Length of minimizer k-mers.

options.label: Minimizer window size
options.description: Window size used to select minimizers.

options.label: Mismatch penalty
options.description: Penalty assigned to a mismatch.

options.label: Gap-open penalties
options.description: Short and long gap-open penalties.

options.label: Gap-extension penalties
options.description: Short and long gap-extension penalties.

options.label: Use = and X CIGAR operators
options.description: Distinguish matches and mismatches in CIGAR output.

options.label: Write MD tags
options.description: Add the MD mismatch tag to SAM records.

tools.label: meryl count
tools.summary: Counts reference k-mers used to identify repeats for Winnowmap.

options.label: Memory limit (GB)
options.description: Approximate memory limit passed as memory=GB.

options.label: Worker threads
options.description: Thread count passed as threads=N.

tools.label: meryl print
tools.summary: Prints the high-frequency k-mers selected for Winnowmap. Threshold and database identity are workflow-owned.

tools.label: featureCounts
tools.summary: Primary integer gene counting and strand-orientation auditing.

options.label: Assign multi-overlap reads
options.description: Assign a read to every overlapping feature instead of treating it as ambiguous.

options.label: Count multi-mapping reads
options.description: Include reads reported at multiple genomic locations.

options.label: Choose largest overlap
options.description: Assign each read to the feature with the largest overlap.

options.label: Minimum overlapping bases
options.description: Minimum read bases that must overlap a feature.

options.label: Minimum read overlap fraction
options.description: Minimum fraction of the read that must overlap a feature.

options.label: Ignore duplicate-marked reads
options.description: Exclude reads carrying the duplicate flag.

tools.label: HTSeq count
tools.summary: Alternative gene-counting engine for position-sorted BAM files.

options.label: Minimum alignment quality
options.description: Skip alignments below this MAPQ threshold.

options.label: Secondary alignments
options.description: Choose whether secondary alignments affect ambiguity scoring or are ignored.

options.label: Supplementary alignments
options.description: Choose whether supplementary alignments affect ambiguity scoring or are ignored.

options.label: Maximum buffered reads
options.description: Buffer limit used for paired reads in position order.

tools.label: FADU
tools.summary: Optional bacterial overlap-aware fractional-count audit. Its current workflow-critical arguments are protected.

tools.label: deepTools bamCoverage
tools.summary: Creates raw or CPM-normalized strand-aware BigWig/bedGraph coverage tracks.

options.label: Smoothing window length
options.description: Average neighboring bins over this window; values not exceeding bin size have no effect.

options.label: Center reads/fragments
options.description: Center each read or fragment before calculating coverage.

options.label: Ignore duplicate reads
options.description: Exclude reads with identical mapping positions according to deepTools rules.

options.label: Skip uncovered regions
options.description: Omit zero-coverage regions instead of writing zero-valued bins.

options.label: Additional scale factor
options.description: Multiply the pipeline-computed coverage values by this factor.
